We have set long term goals that will benefit both the education system and the society. With innovative IT support and learning procedures, TEPTH has made it quite expedient for the students to pass online exams. Our latest learning techniques allow you to score more with less effort. Whether you are preparing for IELTS, CELPIP G, CAEL, PTE, TOEFL iBT and OET, TEPTH is your one pit stop for all your exam preparation needs.

FAQsPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQsPage.description: Everything you need to know about registration, courses, and our facilities.

faqs.question: How do I register?
faqs.answer: Since you are already on our website, the fastest way is to register online. You can also register in person at the center.

faqs.question: Do you offer individual tutoring?
faqs.answer: Yes, both group and one-to-one tutoring are available.

faqs.question: Is the material fee refundable?
faqs.answer: No, the material fee is included and not refundable.

faqs.question: What happens if I cancel or withdraw?
faqs.answer: Please refer to our refund policy for details.

faqs.question: Online registration is not working. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Make sure cookies and JavaScript are enabled. You will receive a confirmation email if your registration is successful. If not, please retry or check your email address.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: Visa, MasterCard, and PayPal are accepted.

faqs.question: What qualifications do your teachers have?
faqs.answer: Our teachers hold bachelor's or master's degrees and certifications such as CELTA, with international teaching experience.

faqs.question: Do you offer facilities for special needs candidates?
faqs.answer: Yes, our centre is fully accessible.

faqs.question: Do you offer a quiet learning environment?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide dedicated noise-free classrooms and testing labs.

faqs.question: Do you offer evening classes?
faqs.answer: Yes, our working hours are 9:00 am – 9:00 pm (Saturday–Thursday).

faqs.question: Can I get brochures or flyers?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can request them via email at info@tepth.net. Content matches our website.

faqs.question: Is public transport available nearby?
faqs.answer: Yes, buses from Al Rashidiya and Burjuman stop near Dubai Silicon Oasis, within a short walking distance.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.p1: A privacy policy is a document that tells our website’s users what will be done with their personal information, how this information will be collected, and how this gathered data will be used.
intro.p2: While storing, managing, and using all information available on the site’s database, all legal requirements are fulfilled to protect client confidentiality. All possible security measures are embedded when site owners deal with visitors’ personal information.

statement.title: Statement
statement.quote: TEPTH has created this privacy policy with the aim of demonstrating our concern and commitment towards maintaining customer secrecy.
statement.p1: Our privacy policy holds great importance for us. It communicates our information collection process and dissemination practices for gathered information from our visitors and customers.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.p1: This policy explains how we tackle and share (if needed) the information you share with us. Website users are informed that their information will be used for two primary reasons:
items: Disclosing personal information to third parties (legal affiliates, business partners, etc.)
Making use of gathered information for particular purposes (newsletters, promotional emails, etc.)

collection.title: Collected Information
collection.p1: TEPTH requires users who register for our services to furnish contact information including name, address, phone number, e-mail contact, billing information, and credit card numbers.

pii.title: Personally Identifiable Information (PII)
pii.p1: PII collected by TEPTH will solely belong to the customers and will be used exclusively according to the legitimate international privacy standards for both offline and online data.
items: To set up and improve our services for individuals and organizations.
To contact customers regarding their specific interests in TEPTH.
To facilitate promotional campaigns via authorized partners.
To send email newsletters (only if an email address is provided).
pii.p2: We will not distribute your personal information haphazardly. If we share your information with third parties, we will ask for your approval first.

nonPii.title: Information that is not PII
nonPii.p1: We may also collect non-PII such as Internet addresses, navigational data, and cookies. This information is logged to help govern our site and diagnose technical problems.
nonPii.p2: Today, cookies utilization is the industry standard. standing alone, these cannot identify you personally. We recommend letting your web browser accept cookies to access a fully functional website.

security.title: Security and Retention
security.p1: TEPTH ensures that user-provided personal information is safeguarded against potentially illegal access, disclosure, or misuse.

items.text: Personal information is stored in a secured server environment using firewalls.
Only employees with signed confidentiality agreements have authorized access.
TEPTH destroys information that is no longer required for its intended reason.

changes.title: Changes to the Policy
changes.p1: TEPTH authorities can make changes to this privacy policy anytime. We may send you an email advising of modifications, or we may post them on the website.

SpecialAccommodationPage.title: Available
SpecialAccommodationPage.description: We offer various modifications based on documented medical conditions, disabilities, or specific learning requirements.

additionalTime.title: Additional Time
additionalTime.desc: Standard 25% to 50% extra time for candidates with cognitive processing speeds, physical disabilities, or visual impairments that require more time to navigate materials.

visualAids.title: Visual Aids
visualAids.desc: Large print papers, Braille versions, and screen magnifier software for candidates with varying degrees of visual impairment.

privateRoom.title: Private Room
privateRoom.desc: Distraction-free environments for candidates requiring specialized medical equipment or frequent breaks.

assistivePersonnel.title: Assistive Personnel
assistivePersonnel.desc: Qualified scribes, readers, and sign-language interpreters can be provided to assist candidates in conveying their knowledge accurately.

steps.title: Initial Request
steps.desc: Submit your request during the initial exam registration phase. We recommend applying at least 6 weeks before your test date.

steps.title: Documentation Upload
steps.desc: Provide valid medical evidence from a registered practitioner outlining the nature of the requirement and recommended adjustments.

steps.title: Review & Approval
steps.desc: Our specialist board reviews the request against exam body criteria and issues a Formal Approval Notice via email.
